clusters.headline: Africa: Why Do Most African Countries Stay with the ICC?
clusters.summary: [DW] A new wave of African withdrawals has swept through the International Criminal Court. Chad turned its back on the court after three junta-led states in the Sahel exited. But most African countries still trust The Hague.
